text_block_list.text: I... I've won... I've... really won!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Congrats, McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
That's McQueen for ya! She's done it
again!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
I lost again, huh... Guess I was always
just—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: You're a real fighter, Ryan!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... You stuck it out to the very end! You were so awesome, Ryan!
text_block_list.name: Spectator D

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You Mejiros are really somethin' else!
Way to go,
you two!
text_block_list.name: Spectator E

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the incredible race, you two!
I'll never,
ever forget it!
text_block_list.name: Spectator F

text_block_list.text: Everyone...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Th-they're talking about me too?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
They are, Ryan! You exhibited your
power to the
very end!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
They've all been enchanted by your
display of
strength! By how you never
surrendered, never
turned from the
challenge ahead!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: My... strength?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I-it's... it's like they know me better than
I know
myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Which must mean... I really am strong.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! You're right! Thanks so much for
cheering
me on, folks!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The curtains close on the Takarazuka
Kinen with
Мэдзиро МакКуин as the
winner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, although the Takarazuka Kinen has
come to
a close...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Competing with Ryan has allowed me to
see my
next goal.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
My next objective shall be the autumn
Tenno
Sho, following my win in the
spring—the Twin
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It is a feat yet to be achieved by anyone
in the
Mejiro family.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Now that Grandmother has entrusted me
with the
task...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I want to show her, and everyone else in
my
family, a new path forward.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Yes, without fail!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A fire burns in Мэдзиро МакКуин's eyes as
she sets
her sights on this new
goal—successive wins in the
Twin Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
